observation: Authorized publisher rejected its pre-commit whitespace gate. Preserved CRLF snapshots were incorrectly treated as text whitespace. No implementation commit or tag was created by that attempt.
resolution: Preserve exact source/proof bytes with scoped -text attributes, recognize CRLF line endings for source whitespace checks, and mark raw streams/snapshots non-diffable without rewriting them. Then rerun focused verification and authorized publication.
